def factor_crash_tail_skew_volume_asymmetry(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    ret = close.pct_change()
    skew = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=30).skew()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    factor = -skew * down_ratio
    factor = factor.clip(lower=-3, upper=3)
    df_copy["factor_crash_tail_skew_volume_asymmetry"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_crash_tail_skew_volume_asymmetry"]
description: Accumulating negative return skewness combined with increasing downside volume participation signals rising crash fragility. Negative skew indicates fat left tail; high downside volume ratio confirms distribution shift. This tail-distribution plus volume flow pathway is distinct from prior volatility asymmetry and drawdown factors.
